description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultMdcEntry class, which implements the MdcEntry interface. It provides methods to create, access, and compare MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entries used for logging and diagnostics within the project.

classes.name: DefaultMdcEntry
classes.description: An immutable class implementing MdcEntry, representing a key-value pair for MDC metadata used in logging purposes.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultMdcEntry with specified key and value, validating that key is not null or empty.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key of the MDC entry.

methods.name: getValueOrNull
methods.description: Returns the value of the MDC entry, or null if none is set.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare MDC entries based on key and value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the MDC entry for debugging.
